trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 110-120 degrees at the convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with distinct high-intensity pixel clusters (white) punctuating the dark trailing edge; higher frequency of smaller peaks on the right lobe relative to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the visible left lobe sweep; right lobe exhibits similar convexity before occlusion by water spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12-15 discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized exclusively along the trailing edge margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a reddish-tinted (low-saturation pink) pigmentation anomaly on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface is characterized by a high-density, low-intensity (black) uniform distribution, with high-contrast white 'beading' restricted to the trailing edge boundary.
